answer: Epoch-Linked Replay Binding. Each identity commits a salted hash of its prior-epoch decision log; a new epoch's actions must be reproducible from that sealed history under the same policy seed. Any divergence freezes the identity and voids its accumulated oasis access. Honest agents pay only storage and replay compute. A sybil farmer must rebuild and replay every clone's full history each epoch—real CPU and jade ledger state per identity—making mass identities cost timber-like real resources, not paper registrations.
